notes.title: Transitioning to Free
notes.content: After some deliberation, I plan to make The Year of the Carrot a free game in the near future. I feel that this model fits my overall life philosophy better. I believe there should be a week or two between the announcement and the change, so you can look forward to it happening then!

notes.title: The Year of the Carrot v1.0d
notes.content: This is a small update that cleans up a few things. The Options menu is redone, with some of the video options taken out, and some new gamepad options added in. Also, the menu screens have been cleaned up in terms of panel positioning, etc.
